name: services/facperms/replace
description: INSERT new or UPDATE existing user-faculty-permission row.
brief_description: INSERT new or UPDATE existing user-faculty-permission row.

arguments.name: with_subfaculties
arguments.description: By default, the permissions are propagated down the tree of facultues. Set this to false if you want the permission to effect only this single faculty (without its subfaculties).

arguments.name: auto_remove_redundant
arguments.description:
By default, if the change would have rendered some of the existing permissions redundant, then the change will be aborted (with a proper user message).

Set this to true if you'd like all the redundant entries removed instead.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
{"success": true, "existed": false} if the insert succeeded.

{"success": true, "existed": true} if the exact same row was already present and it was updated.

In case of failure, use the user_messages field to display a proper message for the user.
